_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoP61wgAn6oVSrkKUd7MGMz4)_

Fixes #28185
Fixes #28184

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改一个测试文件，在 flow 值账本的固定清单里补上第 19 条 `connector_action:input.*`，并在注释里说明它来自 #27968 / #28150。
- 为什么改：#28150 给表达式账本新增了这一条，但 ui 里的测试还钉着旧的 18 条，导致 `main` 上 `Test UI` 变红，合并队列里的每个 PR 都被踢出。
- 风险与回滚：仅测试，不发布任何包，不改运行时行为；"六个键值映射"那条断言原样不动。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-value-envelope.test.ts` 第 71–82 行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-value-envelope.test.ts`，预期 11/11 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`flow-value-envelope.test.ts`, case "offers the envelope on exactly the six hand-table key/value maps the ledger names": the expected `value`-role list of `FLOW_NODE_EXPRESSION_PATHS` gains `'connector_action:input.*'` (sorted, between `assignment:assignments.*` and `create_record:fields.*`), and the comment above it says the list grew at #27968 / #28150 with the one entry rooted in `connectorConfig`. The six-map `offered` assertion is unchanged: `isValueEnvelopeSlot` answers only for `config`-rooted maps.
